entries.text: ARES and LettuceDetect were both scored on RAGTruth, so two of the three families already meet on one dataset. The gap is a comparison of all three on the same answers; say that, or a reviewer who knows RAGTruth will.
Good catch. I'll narrow it to all three and cite the RAGTruth numbers from both.
